description: This file contains unit tests for the AudioChannelLayoutMixer class, testing its ability to mix audio data into different channel configurations (mono, stereo, quad, 5.1) with various sample and storage types.

classes.name: AudioChannelLayoutMixerTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the AudioChannelLayoutMixer with various sample and storage types.

methods.name: GetTestDecodedAudio
methods.description: Generates a DecodedAudio object with test audio data for a specified number of channels.

methods.name: AssertExpectedAndOutputMatch
methods.description: Asserts that the output audio matches the expected data, considering sample type and storage format.

methods.name: GetAudioChannelLayoutMixerTestConfigName
methods.description: Generates a descriptive name for the test configuration based on sample and storage types.
